exposure: Power Business Intelligence (BI) program focusing on antibiotic prescriptions for post-cesarean infection surveillance
outcome: Effectiveness of post-cesarean infection surveillance (measured by sensitivity and specificity)
cohort: All patients who underwent cesarean section between January 1, 2019, and September 30, 2020.
finding: The Power BI method, focusing on antibiotic prescriptions, demonstrated high sensitivity (100%) and specificity (93%) for detecting surgical site infections and significantly reduced the workload by 91% compared to traditional surveillance.
